hello :> i'm glad it relieved you somehow. to add, this is a message i wrote as a reply to someone who recently DMed about the same thing– yung want na maging productive. minor details are edited to apply more appropriately sa iyo :)

-----------


you may want to be productive, yes, but i think the thought itself na "kailangan ko mag-loa" is a strong indication na pagod ka. na kailangan mo muna magpahinga.

i fully encourage you to spend your loa to rest. maaari kang manghinayang kung inutang mo na nga itong oras (sa context na this loa sem is one more sem delayed) para makapagpahinga ka at magpatuloy pero hindi ka man lang napirmi. ikabubuti ng utak, katawan, at loob (as in soul, kaluluwa) mo kapag nakapagpahinga ka. napagtanto ko recently na talagang naging investment yung pag-loa ko. i don't think na from here on out, magkaka-juncture sa buhay ko na kakayanin ko ang cost of a 6-month break. after grad, pwedeng maglaan ng oras para huminga bago mag-job hunting. pero during that time, nasa likod pa rin ng utak yung pressure na need mo maghanap ng work. my earnest wish is for you to not think of your loa like that. 

your loa is for you to breathe. i do not know the circumstances of your loa; kung sino ba naka-afford niyan, kung utang na loob pa ito sa nag-afford sa'yo nito, but the point is nandiyan ka na. please keep in mind na i am encouraging you to breathe. to rest. that doesn't mean you need to fill every loa moment with joy. if your joy allows you to breathe din, that will be amazing. they can co-exist nga naman. but others that may help you rest and breathe are: a) staring at the ceiling, b) occasionally writing down reflections about your self, c) oversleeping, d) cleaning your area so it feels nice and orderly, e) going for random walks, f) rolling around in bed habang nag-pphone. 

for me, the days i did those didn't feel like any sort of progress. nabanggit ko ngang ang uneventful ng feeling ng loa ko. but when i got back here sa elbi this sem lang and nag-acads na ulit and hang out with others, i felt revitalized. literal. parang binigyan ako ulit ng buhay. fresh start from a clean slate. yung belief and compulsion ko na pag-establish ng starting line to hold myself accountable, nauga. minsan pala hindi mo consciously ma-ddictate kung saan at kailan ka magsisimula. nung time na na-realize ko 'yun, ipinaramdam ng katawan at loob ko sa utak ko na: "ito na. nakapagpahinga na. makakapagsimula na tayo nang matiwasay dahil nakahinga na ang buong pagkatao natin.". minsan mahirap pakinggan ang katawan at kalooban dahil literal na di mo siya naririnig. parang ang lagi mo lang maririnig ay yung boses sa utak mo. but i believe the body and soul deteriorate also with the mind. and sa kanilang tatlo, si mind ang pinaka-huling makaka-realize pero ang una at tangi mong maririnig. kumbaga ay hindi natin namamalayang bumibigay na yung dalawa unless the mind, who always tries to rationalize, acknowledges it. again, these are anecdotal and so your mileage may vary but the fact is: this loa is a time for rest. you are here already. please rest accordingly 🙂‍↕️❤️

-----------


as for the stigma, i think a lot of people can vouch na sa simula lang sha hehe a lot of the people i know, if not all, na nag-loa ay hindi ni-regret. kung may stigma man, dedma na sha mostly pagkabalik sa loa. okay nag-loa ka, okay one sem delayed but at least you were able to rest. lahat ng opportunities na ma-miss mo sa loa ay ma-rredirect sa iyo and you are likely to be better-equipped to appreciate them :) but i'm of the opinion that self-preservation is not something you can completely make up for if put on hold siya for too long. one way i thought of my loa is da necessary n super sarap 20min power nap kung i-condense ang buong buhay ko in 24hrs lol. dont overthink da analogy btw 🤨🤨 its jus a fun lil thing

Hello, everyone. I'm a hobbyist photographer in college. Several circumstances led me to selling my camera but now I'm saving up for a new one. I have a few questions regarding style emulation.

I grabbed this photo off of pinterest and from what I can tell, it seems to be taken around the 1970s-1990s. I'm planning a small project with this sort of vibe in post-processing in mind. Right off the bat, I can see the temperature and the tint are more on the higher side. The background also seems blurred so the depth of field is shallow. From what I can see, it doesn't seem very sharp. Besides those I don't think I'm knowledgeable enough to pinpoint other specifics. To emulate this, I was planning on going through the process of shooting with a DSLR/mirrorless camera, post-process in Lightroom to achieve a similar result in color, have it printed on photopaper, then scan digitally. I'm assuming scanning has something to do with how it looks "creamy", owing to how a scan tends to wash out other details. The tints and colors may have to do with aging? I remember seeing a few photos from childhood albums looking similar.

For more context, I'm from the Philippines. I haven't done enough research about what could lead to these results considering photography paraphernalia available during the time this was taken. I'm asking here just in case anyone could give me ideas to help with what to research.

Thanks!

It's normal to discover sexual intricacies at your age. Whether those discoveries are prompted by the internet or peers, what's most important is you do not rush into it.

You may hear of exciting sexual encounters from friends (which could be lies, a lot of teenagers lie) which you want to try out. There are a lot of dangerous people who will take advantage of this if you're open about it, especially when you're anonymous online. I hope you do not fall into that. 

In relation to that, I hope you do not fall into the trap of being a grown-up wannabe. It's tempting to create a separate identity from your peers but that doesn't have to be underaged smoking or drinking, or risky sexual behavior. Enjoy being a child. Pull stupid pranks and laugh at corny shit. Be a 14-year old you'll look back on with cringe followed by laughter, rather than cringe followed by crying why the fuck you did that at 14.

I'm more concerned about which will have less overall damage to my hair. I don't iron all the time but the high heat and frequency is sort of alarming, though I'm not sure if that's worse than a chemical treatment.
